title: Sikh congregational worship (Sangat)
subject: History
caption: Sikh congregation (Sangat) arranged around the Guru Granth Sahib during collective worship.
altText: A textbook-quality illustration showing a Sikh worship gathering called Sangat. In the center, a raised wooden platform holds the Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture, labeled accordingly. Surrounding the platform are rows of worshippers seated on the floor, both men and women in traditional Sikh attire, each labeled as male or female worshipper. Some individuals hold prayer beads (mala), one person is reading from the scripture, and a couple of musicians are playing a harmonium and tabla, all labeled. The background is plain white, and arrows with labels point to each element, providing a clear, accurate visual guide to the arrangement of worshippers in a Sikh congregation.
